treatment_plan.notes: 1. You can eat immediately. Do not eat sticky or hard food. 2. If the resin material detaches within 3 months, you can refill it once for free. 3. Maintain oral hygiene, develop good habits of brushing and flossing correctly and conscientiously, conduct regular oral examinations every 3-6 months, and follow up if any discomfort occurs.
